meta.name: audit-my-app
meta.description: Sweep a whole running web app for what is broken, without writing a script or knowing the codebase. Clicks every reachable control and reports dead buttons, console errors, failed requests, and places where the API and the screen disagree. Use on an unfamiliar codebase, before a release, after a big merge or dependency bump, when the user asks for a smoke test or a health check, or when someone says "just check everything still works".

copy.tagline: 替你点遍网页里的每个按钮,把打不开的控件和报错列成清单。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接手了别人的项目,或正要发版、心里没底想先确认一切还能正常跑。
copy.tagline_en: Click through every control in a running web app and list what's broken.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're taking over an unfamiliar app or about to ship and want proof it still works.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把正在运行的应用里所有能点到的控件都点一遍,报告死按钮、控制台报错、失败请求,以及 API 与页面显示不一致的地方。
howto.when: 在发布前、大合并或依赖升级后,或面对陌生代码库时触发;你要求冒烟测试或健康检查时也会接管。

say.text: 我没碰过这个代码库,先做一次健康检查
say.note: 会报告死按钮、报错和失败请求

say.text: 接口和页面显示对不上,帮我比对一下

howto.what_en: Claude sweeps a running web app: it clicks every reachable control and reports dead buttons, console errors, failed requests, and places where the API and the screen disagree.
howto.when_en: Triggers on an unfamiliar codebase, before a release, or after a big merge or dependency bump, and when you ask for a smoke test or health check.

say_en.text: Click through my running app and tell me what's broken
say_en.note: Crawls every reachable control and reports anomalies

say_en.text: I've never seen this codebase - run a health check first

say_en.text: The API returned ten rows but the page shows nine - check it
